history.administration_response: The enterprise risk management focal point workshop, initially scheduled for March 2024, was delayed owing to the liquidity situation of the Secretariat. It was expected to be scheduled in the fall of 2024 or the winter of 2025, depending on the availability of resources. One day during the workshop in Brindisi, or another day, could be dedicated to peacekeeping risk awareness, in which field missions could discuss relevant thematic risk areas through facilitated brainstorming to raise awareness and build a more risk-aware culture in peacekeeping missions. The Administration also presented evidence of enterprise risk management action (briefings, meetings and training sessions) conducted in MONUSCO in November 2024.
history.board_assessment: If and when said workshop, including a risk awareness session, is organized, the recommendation will be considered implemented.

history.sg_progress: To support risk awareness and develop a more risk-aware culture, the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance conducted site visits in 2024 to assist two peacekeeping missions – MONUSCO and UNSOS – with their risk assessments. Furthermore, to raise awareness of fraud and corruption, in 2023 the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance developed training on raising awareness of fraud and corruption, which is accessible through the Capacity Development and Operational Training Service campus and is a complement to the Fraud and Corruption Awareness Handbook. In December 2024, the Department published an iSeek article entitled “Join the fight against corruption”, which is available to all entities in the Secretariat. The enterprise risk management focal points’ workshop, initially planned for March 2024, was delayed owing to the Secretariat’s liquidity constraints. It is now expected to be held in the second quarter of 2025, subject to the availability of resources. The workshop will include a dedicated session on peacekeeping risk awareness, during which field missions will engage in facilitated brainstorming in order to identify key risk areas, foster awareness and strengthen the risk-conscious culture.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration organize an annual “peacekeeping risk management day”, in order to raise awareness and develop, including through proper brainstorming and training sessions, a more risk-aware culture in the peacekeeping missions.
history.administration_response: The Administration requests the closure of this recommendation because it was implemented. On 8 May 2025, the Business Transformation and Accountability Division hosted the first annual “peacekeeping risk management day”, a virtual event that brought together more than 200 participants from across the Secretariat, which included all field missions. The session thoroughly addressed enterprise risk management in peace operations and focused on promoting a culture of risk awareness. Key topics included innovations in enterprise risk management, navigating geopolitical shifts and integrating risk considerations into planning and budgeting. In addition to brainstorming and training sessions on that day, an iSeek article highlighting the event was published to reach a broader audience.
history.board_assessment: In view of the provided information and supporting evidence, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
